memory_search.name: memory_search
memory_search.description: Search personal memory across notes, document chunks, episodes, and semantic summaries. Use this to find relevant information from the user's knowledge base.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: The search query to find relevant memories

parameters.name: scopes
parameters.description: Which types of memory to search. Defaults to all types.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 6)

notes_create.name: notes_create
notes_create.description: Create a new note with optional title and content. The note will be automatically embedded for semantic search.

parameters.name: title
parameters.description: Optional title for the note

parameters.name: content
parameters.description: The note content

notes_search.name: notes_search
notes_search.description: Search through notes using keywords or semantic similarity.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Search query for finding notes

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of notes to return (default: 10)

notes_edit.name: notes_edit
notes_edit.description: Edit an existing note's title or content. The note will be re-embedded after editing.

parameters.name: note_id
parameters.description: The ID of the note to edit

parameters.name: title
parameters.description: New title for the note

parameters.name: content
parameters.description: New content for the note

notes_delete.name: notes_delete
notes_delete.description: Delete a note by its ID. This action cannot be undone.

parameters.name: note_id
parameters.description: The ID of the note to delete

notes_list.name: notes_list
notes_list.description: List all notes for the user, optionally filtered by folder. Returns note IDs, titles, and preview of content.

parameters.name: folder_id
parameters.description: Optional folder ID to filter notes by folder

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of notes to return (default: 20)

reminders_create.name: reminders_create
reminders_create.description: Create a new reminder with text and due date/time. The due_at parameter should be an ISO 8601 datetime string.

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: The reminder text/message

parameters.name: due_at
parameters.description: When the reminder should trigger (ISO 8601 datetime format, e.g., '2024-01-15T14:30:00Z')

reminders_list.name: reminders_list
reminders_list.description: List reminders for a specific day or all upcoming reminders. Can filter by status (scheduled, completed, cancelled).

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Optional date to filter reminders (YYYY-MM-DD format). If not provided, shows all upcoming reminders.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by status (scheduled, completed, cancelled). Defaults to 'scheduled'.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of reminders to return (default: 20)

reminders_cancel.name: reminders_cancel
reminders_cancel.description: Cancel a reminder by ID. This sets the reminder status to 'cancelled'.

parameters.name: reminder_id
parameters.description: The ID of the reminder to cancel

timers_start.name: timers_start
timers_start.description: Start a new timer with optional label and duration. Use duration_seconds for precise durations (e.g., 30 seconds, 90 seconds). For longer timers, can use duration in minutes. If no duration is provided, defaults to 25 minutes.

parameters.name: label
parameters.description: Optional label/description for the timer

parameters.name: duration
parameters.description: Duration in minutes. Deprecated - use duration_seconds for more precision.

parameters.name: duration_seconds
parameters.description: Duration in seconds. Takes priority over duration if both provided.

timers_status.name: timers_status
timers_status.description: Check the status of all active timers, including time remaining and whether they've completed.

parameters.name: include_completed
parameters.description: Whether to include recently completed timers (default: false)

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of timers to return (default: 10)

timers_cancel.name: timers_cancel
timers_cancel.description: Cancel a running timer by ID. This sets the timer status to 'cancelled'.

parameters.name: timer_id
parameters.description: The ID of the timer to cancel

start_shadow_session.name: start_shadow_session
start_shadow_session.description: Start a SHADOW MODE session (NOT a timer) to automatically capture browser activity, VS Code files, tasks, decisions, and ideas from a desktop agent. Use this when the user says 'shadow me', 'start shadow mode', 'shadow session', or wants to track their work activity automatically.

parameters.name: duration_minutes
parameters.description: Duration of the session in minutes (e.g., 2, 30, 60, 90)

parameters.name: context
parameters.description: Optional context describing what you'll be working on

calendar_list.name: calendar_list
calendar_list.description: List calendar events for a date range. If no dates are provided, shows events for the current week.

parameters.name: start_date
parameters.description: Start date for event listing (YYYY-MM-DD format). Defaults to today.

parameters.name: end_date
parameters.description: End date for event listing (YYYY-MM-DD format). Defaults to 7 days from start_date.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of events to return (default: 50)

calendar_create.name: calendar_create
calendar_create.description: Create a new calendar event with title, start/end times, and optional location and description.

parameters.name: title
parameters.description: The event title

parameters.name: starts_at
parameters.description: Event start time (ISO 8601 datetime format, e.g., '2024-01-15T14:30:00Z')

parameters.name: ends_at
parameters.description: Event end time (ISO 8601 datetime format, e.g., '2024-01-15T15:30:00Z')

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: Optional event location

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: Optional event description

knowledge_graph_search.name: knowledge_graph_search
knowledge_graph_search.description:
🧠 Search across ALL of your knowledge - notes, conversations, and documents - using advanced graph intelligence. 
        This tool can find content by topic, discover related items, and show connections between different types of content.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Search query to find relevant content across all types

parameters.name: content_types
parameters.description: Optional filter for specific content types (default: all types)

parameters.name: include_connections
parameters.description: Whether to include connected content in results (default: true)

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 15)

find_connections.name: find_connections
find_connections.description:
🔗 Discover what content is connected to a specific note, conversation, or document. 
        Shows direct and indirect relationships, helping understand how ideas are linked in your knowledge.

parameters.name: content_id
parameters.description: ID of the content to find connections for

parameters.name: depth
parameters.description: How many degrees of connection to explore (1=direct, 2=friends of friends, etc.)

parameters.name: connection_types
parameters.description: Optional filter for specific relationship types (REFERENCES, SEMANTIC_SIMILAR, etc.)

discover_knowledge_clusters.name: discover_knowledge_clusters
discover_knowledge_clusters.description:
🧩 Discover knowledge clusters and communities in your content using advanced graph algorithms.
        Finds groups of related content and identifies knowledge themes.

parameters.name: min_cluster_size
parameters.description: Minimum size for clusters to report (default: 3)

analyze_knowledge_gaps.name: analyze_knowledge_gaps
analyze_knowledge_gaps.description:
🔍 Analyze your knowledge graph to identify gaps, isolated content, and potential connections.
        Helps discover orphaned content and suggests areas for knowledge expansion.

parameters.name: isolation_threshold
parameters.description: Consider items with fewer than this many connections as isolated (default: 2)

web_search.name: web_search
web_search.description: Search the web using SearXNG. Returns a compact summary with top 5 results (title, URL, 200-char snippet). This summary is usually sufficient to answer most questions. Full details are stored temporarily if needed later.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Search query

parameters.name: recency
parameters.description: Result freshness preference

parameters.name: sites
parameters.description: Optional site filters (e.g., 'docs.python.org')

parameters.name: max_results
parameters.description: Maximum results to return

get_web_search_details.name: get_web_search_details
get_web_search_details.description: Retrieve full details of a previous web search using its reference ID. ONLY use this if the compact summary from web_search was insufficient to answer the user's question. The summary usually contains enough information - avoid calling this unless truly necessary.

parameters.name: reference_id
parameters.description: The reference ID from a previous web_search call

open_page.name: open_page
open_page.description: Open a web page and return a compact summary with title and first 500 chars of content. This preview is usually sufficient for most questions. Full page content is stored if needed later.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: URL to open

get_page_details.name: get_page_details
get_page_details.description: Retrieve full page content from a previous open_page call using its reference ID. ONLY use this if the 500-char preview from open_page was insufficient to answer the question. The preview usually contains enough information - avoid calling this unless truly necessary.

parameters.name: reference_id
parameters.description: The reference ID from a previous open_page call

fitness_note_create.name: fitness_note_create
fitness_note_create.description: Create a fitness note with title, content, and category. Categories: nutrition, workout, goal, progress, general. Notes are automatically embedded for semantic search.

parameters.name: title
parameters.description: Title for the note

parameters.name: content
parameters.description: The note content

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Note category

fitness_note_search.name: fitness_note_search
fitness_note_search.description: Search through fitness notes using keywords or semantic similarity. Optionally filter by category.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Search query

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Filter by category

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum results (default: 10)

fitness_note_edit.name: fitness_note_edit
fitness_note_edit.description: Edit an existing fitness note's title, content, or category. The note will be re-embedded after editing.

parameters.name: note_id
parameters.description: The ID of the note to edit

parameters.name: title
parameters.description: New title

parameters.name: content
parameters.description: New content

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: New category

food_search_and_log.name: food_search_and_log
food_search_and_log.description: PREFERRED TOOL for logging meals. Parse natural language food descriptions (e.g., '3 eggs and 4oz ground beef' or 'chicken breast 6oz and rice 1 cup'), automatically search USDA nutrition database for accurate data, calculate nutritional totals, and log the meal. Use this whenever the user mentions eating food in natural language. This provides accurate USDA nutrition data instead of estimates.

parameters.name: user_input
parameters.description: Natural language food description like '3 eggs and 4oz ground beef' or '2 chicken breasts and 1 cup rice'

parameters.name: meal_type
parameters.description: Type of meal

food_log_create.name: food_log_create
food_log_create.description: MANUAL food logging tool - use ONLY when the user provides specific nutrition values (calories, protein, carbs, fats) or when food_search_and_log tool is not appropriate. For natural language food descriptions, use food_search_and_log instead for automatic USDA nutrition lookup.

parameters.name: meal_type
parameters.description: Type of meal

parameters.name: food_description
parameters.description: Simple description of food items (e.g., '3 eggs, 4oz ground beef'). Do NOT use JSON arrays.

parameters.name: calories
parameters.description: Total calories (optional)

parameters.name: protein
parameters.description: Protein in grams (optional)

parameters.name: carbs
parameters.description: Carbohydrates in grams (optional)

parameters.name: fats
parameters.description: Fats in grams (optional)

parameters.name: notes
parameters.description: Additional notes about the meal

parameters.name: logged_at
parameters.description: When the meal was eaten (ISO format, defaults to now)

food_log_search.name: food_log_search
food_log_search.description: Search food log entries by date range. Returns meals with nutritional totals.

parameters.name: start_date
parameters.description: Start date (ISO format, defaults to today)

parameters.name: end_date
parameters.description: End date (ISO format, defaults to today)

parameters.name: meal_type
parameters.description: Filter by meal type (optional)

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum results (default: 20)

food_log_summary.name: food_log_summary
food_log_summary.description: Get nutrition summary for a date range (daily averages, totals, meal distribution).

parameters.name: start_date
parameters.description: Start date (ISO format)

parameters.name: end_date
parameters.description: End date (ISO format)

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: Summary period

workout_list.name: workout_list
workout_list.description: List available workouts, optionally filtered by status (scheduled, completed, all). Shows planned workouts from fitness plans.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by workout status

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum results (default: 20)

workout_log_create.name: workout_log_create
workout_log_create.description: Log exercise sets completed during a workout. Records weight, reps, RPE (Rate of Perceived Exertion 1-10) for each set.

parameters.name: workout_id
parameters.description: ID of the workout being logged (optional - will auto-create today's workout if not provided)

parameters.name: exercise_id
parameters.description: Exercise name or identifier

parameters.name: set_index
parameters.description: Set number (1, 2, 3...)

parameters.name: weight
parameters.description: Weight used (lbs or kg)

parameters.name: reps
parameters.description: Repetitions completed

parameters.name: rpe
parameters.description: Rate of Perceived Exertion (1-10)

parameters.name: notes
parameters.description: Additional notes about the set

parameters.name: session_date
parameters.description: Optional custom workout date in YYYY-MM-DD format (defaults to today)

parameters.name: session_time
parameters.description: Optional full ISO timestamp for exact workout time

workout_details.name: workout_details
workout_details.description: Get detailed workout logs showing all logged sets (weight, reps, RPE) for a specific date or workout session. Use this to see what exercises were performed and how much weight was lifted.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Date to get workout details for (YYYY-MM-DD format). Defaults to today.

parameters.name: workout_id
parameters.description: Optional specific workout ID to get details for

parameters.name: exercise_name
parameters.description: Optional filter by specific exercise name

workout_stats.name: workout_stats
workout_stats.description: Get workout statistics for a date range: total workouts, exercises logged, volume trends.

parameters.name: start_date
parameters.description: Start date (ISO format)

parameters.name: end_date
parameters.description: End date (ISO format)

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: Stats period

recovery_log_create.name: recovery_log_create
recovery_log_create.description: Create or update daily recovery log with metrics like HRV, heart rate, sleep hours, soreness level (1-10), and body weight. Use this when the user shares recovery data or morning metrics.

parameters.name: log_date
parameters.description: Date for the recovery log (YYYY-MM-DD format, defaults to today)

parameters.name: hrv
parameters.description: Heart Rate Variability in milliseconds (optional)

parameters.name: heart_rate
parameters.description: Resting heart rate in BPM (optional)

parameters.name: sleep_hours
parameters.description: Hours of sleep (can include decimals like 7.5)

parameters.name: soreness_level
parameters.description: Muscle soreness on 1-10 scale (1=none, 10=extremely sore)

parameters.name: body_weight
parameters.description: Body weight (optional)

parameters.name: weight_unit
parameters.description: Unit for body weight

parameters.name: notes
parameters.description: Additional notes about recovery, how you feel, injuries, etc.

recovery_log_get.name: recovery_log_get
recovery_log_get.description: Get recovery log for a specific date to see HRV, sleep, soreness, and other metrics from that day.

parameters.name: log_date
parameters.description: Date to retrieve (YYYY-MM-DD format, defaults to today)

recovery_log_recent.name: recovery_log_recent
recovery_log_recent.description: Get recent recovery logs (default: last 7 days) to analyze trends in HRV, sleep quality, soreness patterns, and overall recovery status.

parameters.name: days
parameters.description: Number of days to retrieve (default: 7, max: 90)

template_list.name: template_list
template_list.description: List all workout templates with their scheduled days and exercises

parameters.name: phase_id
parameters.description: Optional: Filter templates by training phase ID

template_get.name: template_get
template_get.description: Get detailed information about a specific workout template including all exercises, sets, reps, and RPE targets

parameters.name: template_id
parameters.description: The ID of the template to retrieve

parameters.name: template_name
parameters.description: Alternatively, the name of the template (case-insensitive partial match)

fitness_summary.name: fitness_summary
fitness_summary.description: Get user's current fitness status: today's nutrition, recent workouts (last 3-7 days), upcoming scheduled workouts, and recovery metrics. Use this when the user asks about their fitness, workouts, nutrition, or training progress.

parameters.name: days_back
parameters.description: Number of days to look back for recent workouts (default: 3)
